mesh_write_stl — FILEIO mesh op

• Data kinds: mesh → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_write_stl(mesh, *, binary) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.mesh_write_stl(mesh, *, binary); from the registry, opsfileio.get("mesh_write_stl"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Write a triangle mesh as ASCII or little-endian binary STL (text / bytes).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

STL は単位を持たない。binary は float32 なので、その精度で往復する。呼び出し例:

mesh_write_stl((vertices, faces), binary=False)。
